reviews.title: Unreliable streams, spoiled results and a deeply frustrating
reviews.text:
Starting a stream on F1 TV is often a struggle, especially during a live Grand Prix. I regularly have to try several times before I can actually get in.

Once the stream finally starts, it frequently cuts out. Restarting it can send me straight to the live action instead of resuming where I left off. Even worse, the app sometimes displays the result while I am only halfway through the race, precisely because its interruptions and login problems have put me behind. Having the result spoiled by the very service I am using to watch the race is incredibly frustrating.

I have an excellent 1 Gbps internet connection, yet these problems keep happening.

The transition from the pre-race show to the race itself is equally annoying. When the pre-race programme ends, I have to manually open a separate race stream and log in again. That often fails too, possibly because of high demand. Why is there no seamless transition between the two?

Unfortunately, Viaplay is no real alternative here in the Netherlands either, because I find its presenters absolutely awful.

For a paid service dedicated to Formula 1, reliably starting a race, keeping it playing and remembering my position should be basic requirements. Instead, watching a Grand Prix becomes a battle with the app.

Overall, a terrible experience that takes much of the enjoyment out of watching F1.

reviews.title: Abysmal is too much flattery
reviews.text:
Writing a review for the android TV here since I for sure will not do that using my remote om the television.

- There is no time table in the app for upcoming live broadcasts. Every streaming/television implementation has this since the Ming dynasty. Step out of feudal middle ages please.

- Somehow the UX designers though they could "improve" on standard controls. It now takes two (obscure) presses on my remote to pause the stream instead of one, or at least obvious on screen pointers to tell me my options. 

- Satans Autoplay. Autoplay makes one of Dantes lower levels feel like a weekend out in a cabana in Mexico with free complimentary beverages and snacks. Not only can you not switch off Autoplay but it also always defaults to the last upload, even if you have already watched it. It will hower not move over to the next Livestream, like going from the pre-race show to the race. This makes you frantically zap your way through many screens to find the correct next stream just in time to have to rewind back to view the cars leave the starting line. By the time you are settled your beverages have gone lukewarm.
